Compose freeze read and render a statutory act by the form of Додаток В from already-recorded facts only; no render exposes a free-text quantity field and the composer refuses a quantity that is not an existing recorded entry (INV-073). v0.1 renders form В only — Додаток Г is v0.2. In v0.1 the freeze is pinned by the stage closure rather than by a package version (ADR-006 decision 4.5; INV-084) and the package version pins it additionally from v0.2. statutory_acts.render was added here 2026-08-06: it is a v0.1-M4 member-plane row of scope-v0.1.csv and was governed by no capability at all ACCEPTED COUPLING, RECORDED 2026-08-18 RATHER THAN SPLIT (owner decision). This one capability_id governs four operations of two kinds: statutory_acts.compose and statutory_act_versions.freeze are POST commands, statutory_acts.get and statutory_acts.render are GET queries. So a member granted read access to an act can also compose and freeze one — read implies write, which is a genuine authorization defect and is not pretended otherwise here. It is not split because in v0.1 NO persona needs read-only act access: the capability sits on pto_engineer alone, and the external reviewer reaches acts through the external plane and a bearer grant, not through this capability. Splitting costs a migration (the capability vocabulary is pinned by project_access_grants_capability_check), four route changes, the preset mapping and its tests — paid for a reader who does not exist yet. The successor is a statutory_acts.view capability for the two GETs, and it should land WITH the first persona that needs to read an act without being able to write one.
